messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (faithfulness) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "brief": "## Problem\nUsers cannot safely merge duplicate records because the system may delete important documents or supplier notes. This forces them to avoid merging, leaving data fragmented and harder to manage.\n\n## Who is affected\n- At least 1 account, Sallowmere Motor, has raised this issue directly [i:de7ff5475341d9cd].\n\n## Evidence\n- The fact sheet shows 1 accounts_n, 1 mentions_n, and 1 routes_n.\n- The mentions_by_route data shows 1 mention from the sales route.\n- A user from Sallowmere Motor asked, can we at least manually merge them without losing any documents or supplier notes? [i:de7ff5475341d9cd].\n- The total ARR figure from the fact sheet is 0 arr_total_gbp.\n- There have been 0 renewals_90d_n.\n\n## Why now\n- The specific customer insight was recorded on 2026-10-06 [i:de7ff5475341d9cd].\n- The fact sheet data is current as of 2026-11-03.",
 "cited_insights": [
  {
   "id": "de7ff5475341d9cd",
   "quote": "can we at least manually merge them without losing any documents or supplier notes?",
   "account": "Sallowmere Motor",
   "route": "sales",
   "date": "2026-10-06T16:28:00Z"
  }
 ],
 "fact_sheet": {
  "as_of": "2026-11-03",
  "accounts_n": 1,
  "mentions_n": 1,
  "routes_n": 1,
  "mentions_by_route": {
   "sales": 1
  },
  "arr_total_gbp": 0,
  "renewals_90d_n": 0,
  "accounts": [
   {
    "name": "Sallowmere Motor",
    "arr_gbp": null,
    "renewal_date": null,
    "mentions": 1
   }
  ]
 }
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "I checked each factual claim against the cited insight and fact sheet. The account (Sallowmere Motor), route (sales), quote wording, and date (2026-10-06) all match the cited insight exactly, and the numbers cited (1 account, 1 mention, 1 route, 1 sales mention, 0 ARR, 0 renewals in 90 days) all match the fact sheet as of 2026-11-03. The scope is appropriately limited ('At least 1 account') and no contrary evidence exists. No overstatement or paraphrase-in-quotes issues found.", "verdict": "pass"}
